messages.content: You can call convert_currency when the user asks about exchange rates.
How much is 250 euros in Japanese yen at the current exchange rate?

message.content:
<think>The user wants to convert 250 euros to Japanese yen. I have the convert_currency function available for this purpose. I need to use:
- from_currency: EUR (euros)
- to_currency: JPY (Japanese yen)
- amount: 250
</think>


<minimax:tool_call>
<invoke name="convert_currency">
<parameter name="amount">250</parameter>
<parameter name="from_currency">EUR</parameter>
<parameter name="to_currency">JPY</parameter>
</invoke>
</minimax:tool_call>
